name: Albalat de la Ribera (Spain)
description: Blue field with five white wavy stripes along the lower part, charged with a yellow lateen-sailed boat.
history: The official flag of Albalat de la Ribera is of proportions 2:3, on a blue field five wavy stripes of white or silver, with at the centre above the waves a boat with a lateen sail of gold or yellow; it was approved by resolution of 18 November 2008 of the First Vice-President and Conseller of the Presidency. The boat alludes to the ferry crossing of Albalat, a medieval privilege that together with the bridges of Cullera and Alzira was one of the crossings of the Xúquer; the arms had been approved by resolution of 17 October 2001.
